# Sleevy documentation

> Scoped index of the Sleevy developer documentation: the REST API, the MCP server, and the conventions an agent needs to drive them. For the whole product, read https://sleevy.app/llms.txt.

Base URL: `https://api.sleevy.app`. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <credential>` — either a personal API Key created at https://sleevy.app/settings, or an OAuth 2.1 access token. Every page below is also served as Markdown by appending `.md`.

## Start here

- [Documentation home](https://sleevy.app/docs/index.md): What Sleevy exposes and which surface to pick.
- [Overview](https://sleevy.app/docs/overview.md): The shape of the API and what it is for.
- [Getting started](https://sleevy.app/docs/getting-started.md): Create a key, capture a URL, read the queue.
- [Core concepts](https://sleevy.app/docs/concepts.md): Saved Items, Links, read state, Folders, and stable IDs.

## Connect an agent

- [MCP](https://sleevy.app/docs/mcp.md): Connect over Streamable HTTP at `https://api.sleevy.app/mcp` with OAuth and scoped consent.
- [Agent authentication](https://sleevy.app/auth.md): Discover, register, claim, use, and revoke a credential.
- [Agent instructions](https://sleevy.app/agent-instructions.md): When to use Sleevy, when not to, and the safety rules.

## Build with the REST API

- [Guides](https://sleevy.app/docs/guides.md): Save, read, update, and organize links from scripts.
- [Retries, batches, and paging](https://sleevy.app/docs/reliability.md): `Idempotency-Key` on writes, `POST /v1/captures/batch` for up to 50 URLs, and cursor paging.
- [Authentication](https://sleevy.app/docs/authentication.md): Personal API Keys and scopes.
- [Errors](https://sleevy.app/docs/errors.md): Structured `code`, `message`, and `resolution` failures.
- [Rate limits](https://sleevy.app/docs/rate-limits.md): `RateLimit-*` headers and `Retry-After`.
- [Versioning and deprecation](https://sleevy.app/docs/versioning.md): `API-Version`, and the six-month `Sunset` promise.
- [API reference](https://sleevy.app/docs/api-reference): Generated from the OpenAPI document.

- [AI catalog](https://sleevy.app/.well-known/ai-catalog.json)
